plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Mitel voice gateway. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, and interface traffic, for MiVoice 5000 (enterprise PEN 2021).
name: VoiceGateway

metrics.name: cpu_usage_percent
metrics.query: avg(cpu_usage_percent{instance_type='voice_gateway', __$labels__}) by (instance_id) or (100 - avg(cpu_idle{instance_type='voice_gateway', __$labels__}) by (instance_id)) or (avg(cpu_user{instance_type='voice_gateway', __$labels__}) by (instance_id) + avg(cpu_system{instance_type='voice_gateway', __$labels__}) by (instance_id))
metrics.description: Overall CPU utilization of the Mitel MiVoice 5000 from UCD-SNMP ssCpuIdle (100 minus idle), falling back to ssCpuUser plus ssCpuSystem when idle is absent.

metrics.name: memory_total
metrics.description: Total real memory of the Mitel MiVoice 5000 (UCD-SNMP memTotalReal, reported in kB and converted to bytes).

metrics.name: memory_free
metrics.description: Available real memory of the Mitel MiVoice 5000 (UCD-SNMP memAvailReal, reported in kB and converted to bytes).

metrics.name: memory_used
metrics.description: Used real memory of the Mitel MiVoice 5000, derived as memTotalReal minus memAvailReal and converted from kB to bytes.

metrics.name: memory_usage_percent
metrics.description: Real memory utilization of the Mitel MiVoice 5000, derived as (memTotalReal - memAvailReal) / memTotalReal * 100.

metrics.name: memory_total_free
metrics.description: Optional total free memory of the Mitel MiVoice 5000 (UCD-SNMP memTotalFree, reported in kB and converted to bytes). Collected when the scalar is present.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
